source.scope: 4.2 p1-p8; narrowly required BOZ assignment/conversion and canonical C1514 premises.

independent_review.source_first: Original 4.2 was read before implementation and observation conclusions. Relevant BOZ, integer-bit, real/IEEE and generic-resolution sources were independently read from the same pin.
independent_review.implementation_corrections: Independently verified in the correction packet, including real-record mutations and an independent comparison of 216 old/new flag and launcher configurations.
independent_review.additional_finding: ECR-001: selected sidecar changes could evade a standalone cached-object snapshot.
independent_review.additional_correction: The coordinator now recollects current cases and compares each selected ID, review key and effective input/metadata/contract fingerprint independently of optional evidence registries. A no-aggregate mid-run sidecar mutation produces provisional status 2 and leaves the baseline writer uncalled. This final correction is coordinator-verified, not represented as another fresh-context review.

source_review_4_2.rationale: The universal execution obligation, processor limits, non-Fortran portability qualification, processor-dependent facilities and advisory documentation modality are unchanged. The new ledger is finite observational infrastructure, not a second program or completed facet. Source completeness, member approval, actual observations and passing effects remain distinct.

contract.inventory_binding: Every current execution ID, primary rule, path, declared plan, metadata/input/profile/requirement fingerprint, execution group and adjudication is included. The current source census and catalogue context are bound. Every group member fingerprint is independently checked before sharing a review key.
contract.inventory_is_not_member_approval: Current explicit needs-oracle/disputed adjudications can be inventoried without approval or qualified passes. They remain listed under members_needing_approval and keep all_members_approved false. Unreviewed/stale or falsely reference-validated evidence cannot be adopted as current inventory.
contract.gates: Whole-suite normal audit/run still refuses unapproved fixtures, and their selected baseline updates are prohibited. Individually approved selections may continue under a current inventory without deleting the unresolved members from the denominator.

execution_consistency.plans: Complete ordered build/link/run plans are reconstructed with shared argv constructors. Exact steps, preceding successes, declared terminal status and executable relationships are enforced.
execution_consistency.configuration: Fortran compiler/mode flags, profile source/executable, launcher/image/arguments, C compilation or C link driver, private processor-header use and source/output paths must match the actual commands.
execution_consistency.inputs: Exact declared input/resource hash sets and the actual supplied stdin hash are checked. Source root and private workspace are explicit invocation provenance.
execution_consistency.outcomes: Contradictory or incomplete success is an infrastructure consistency error and prevents baseline modification. Genuine earlier failures, optional-profile status 77, missing launchers and correctly labelled older modes remain distinguishable. Explicit profiled runtime status 200 remains valid.
execution_consistency.populations: Runtime effects, non-runtime effects, admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid diagnostics have separate denominators. Counts are cases, not inferred passing facets.
execution_consistency.finite_limit: These checks establish internal evidence consistency, not report attestation, universal conformance, complete transitive dependencies or ABI certification.

integer.rationale: 10.2.1.3 p9/Table 10.9 uses destination-kind INT. The four nonnegative, zero-extended bit sequences denote 45, 111, 123 and 255, within the default integer minimum range. GNU f2023 rejects the direct assignment; Flang f2018 executes it but is not qualifying f2023 reference validation.

real.rationale: IEEE arithmetic/model inquiries do not establish the processor-dependent internal bit interpretation used by REAL(BOZ). The four fixed numerical expectations need an independent representation/ordering premise.
real.additional_source_analysis: boz-storage-premise-review.json finds a BOZ-free fixed-width C-integer TRANSFER probe useful but insufficient without an ordering bridge. No profile, forced flag, conversion replacement or oracle approval is invented.

retained_container_contracts.purpose: Preserve C722/C726 source paths and execution IDs while assigning genuine per-execution facets, optional profiles and exact source-cause diagnostics.
retained_container_contracts.invariants: Every original marker ID must be represented exactly once. The filename and default point come from the retained source; explicit spans contain that marker. Orphan/missing/unknown contracts and profiles are errors. Each member has its own review key and effective-contract fingerprint.
retained_container_contracts.current_case_usage: No main-checkout Fortran case uses a sidecar at this checkpoint; the reviewed next-batch authors are implementing the actual migrations.
retained_container_contracts.source_plan_review: batch010-source-review.json; fixture implementation and adjudication remain separate gates.

timeout_cleanup.observed_defect: A transient Flang compile-link timeout reached an unbounded post-kill pipe drain.
timeout_cleanup.repair: Bound pipe draining and process reaping separately, at most one second each, retaining captured partial binary stdout/stderr and the timeout outcome.
timeout_cleanup.regression: An owned child with pipe writers held by the test parent reproduces the old hang under an independent alarm. The repaired path returns within its measured bound and preserves non-UTF8/NUL output.
timeout_cleanup.no_compiler_regression_inferred: Subsequent fresh calibrations completed normally; no compiler source or installed toolchain was changed.

canonical_link.eligibility: Independently confirmed semantically unchanged; renewal requires the current 4.2 source binding.
canonical_link.limit: No duplicate execution, runtime-dispatch claim or computed linked-effect aggregate.

integrated_checkpoint.interpretation: The nonzero normal gate is intentional: one genuinely unresolved oracle remains unapproved. Its passing target output does not authorize its expected representation or make it an XFAIL. This is a reviewed infrastructure checkpoint, not a ready whole suite.
